title: Smith Machine Shrug
summary: A shrug on a fixed bar path for the upper traps.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for traps (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly traps total.
Library rating 0.3 for forearms (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly forearms total.

setup.text: Stand holding the bar at arm's length, hands just outside your thighs.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Lower all the way down for a full stretch.

form_cues.cue: Straight up and down. Rolling your shoulders adds nothing.

mistakes.text: Bending the elbows to pull the bar.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Set safety arms or pins where a missed rep can be set down, or use a spotter, and use collars.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Less isolation, Less stable, Lower loading potential.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only
alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Shoulders pulled down and back, Less upper-trap work, Less isolation.

notes: Ratings, swap attributes and cues are the library model (modeled). An authored page will replace this one.
